content.comment_body: Hello, my [product_name] project is not secured on my Android device. It works well on my PC after installing the root certificate. Can anyone advise me on how to enable security on my Android device too?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is facing an issue where their [product_name] project does not establish a secure connection on an Android device. Installing a root certificate on a PC resolves the problem, but the same approach does not work on Android, pointing to missing instructions or support for mobile platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants guidance to install or activate the root certificate on an Android device to ensure secure access to their [product_name] project.
